top_signals.headline: Bank Indonesia Holds BI-Rate at 5.75% to Support Rupiah Stability
top_signals.impact: The central bank maintained its benchmark rate amid global uncertainty, balancing growth support with currency stability. Foreign reserves remain robust at $151.8B, providing FX intervention capacity.

top_signals.headline: JCI Index Resilient Above 7,200 as Foreign Flows Turn Positive
top_signals.impact: Jakarta Composite Index maintains strength driven by banking and consumer sectors. Net foreign buying resumed as EM sentiment improves on Fed pivot expectations. YTD performance +2.3%.

top_signals.headline: Indonesia Q3 GDP Grows 5.12% YoY, Beats Consensus Estimates
top_signals.impact: Economic expansion driven by household consumption (+4.9%) and fixed investment (+5.1%). Manufacturing PMI at 52.3 signals continued expansion. Full-year growth projected at 5.05-5.15%.

top_signals.headline: Federal Reserve Signals Potential December Rate Cut Amid Cooling Inflation
top_signals.impact: FOMC minutes suggest committee members see conditions for further easing. Core PCE trending toward 2.5% target. Markets pricing 65% probability of 25bp cut in December.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Rupiah Stabilizes at 15,850/USD on Trade Surplus
top_signals.impact: Currency finds support from continued trade surplus ($10.5B Q3) and BI intervention. Carry trade dynamics remain favorable vs USD. Key resistance at 16,000 level.

top_signals.headline: Indonesian Banks Report Strong NIM Expansion in Q3 Results
top_signals.impact: Major banks (BBCA, BBRI, BMRI) posted 12-15% earnings growth with NIMs expanding to 5.2-5.8%. Loan growth accelerated to 11.5% YoY. NPL ratios stable at 2.1-2.4%.

top_signals.headline: S&P 500 Approaches All-Time High on AI Optimism and Rate Cut Bets
top_signals.impact: Index trading near 6,000 level as tech sector leads. Magnificent 7 stocks contribute 60% of YTD gains. Earnings growth re-accelerating to +8% YoY in Q4.

top_signals.headline: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Falls to 4.35% on Dovish Fed Outlook
top_signals.impact: Bond yields decline as markets reprice Fed trajectory. Real yields at +2.0% remain attractive for fixed income allocations. Duration positioning shifts to neutral.

top_signals.headline: 10-year Treasury yield moves higher on stronger-than-expected January jobs report
top_signals.impact: U.S. Treasury yields moved higher Wednesday in response to January job creation that was more than double what Wall Street was expecting.

top_signals.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Expands to 51.5, Supporting EM Sentiment
top_signals.impact: Factory activity strengthens on stimulus measures and export recovery. Positive read-through for Asian supply chains and commodity demand. EM currencies rally.

top_signals.headline: Brent Crude Holds at $78/bbl as OPEC+ Maintains Production Discipline
top_signals.impact: Oil prices stabilize on balanced supply-demand outlook. OPEC+ compliance remains high at 95%. Inventory levels normalize. Range-bound trading expected near term.

top_signals.headline: Incyte Shares Drop 8% Post-Earnings: Analysts Target $104 Amid 2026 Guidance Concerns
top_signals.impact: Incyte (INCY) stock dropped 8% after reporting mixed Q4 2025 results, with revenue beating estimates but EPS missing expectations and 2026 Opzelura sales guidance falling short. top_signals.headline: McDonald’s earnings beat estimates as chain’s value push pays off
top_signals.impact: Buzzy promotions have helped McDonald's win over high-income consumers.

top_signals.headline: Ford reports worst quarterly earnings miss in four years, guides for better 2026
top_signals.impact: Ford Motor reported its first quarterly miss since 2024 and its largest quarterly earnings miss in four years.

top_signals.headline: Scripps launches cost cutting, AI integration in latest effort to generate earnings growth
top_signals.impact: CEO Adam Symson said in an interview with CNBC the changes are intended to alleviate journalists from administrative tasks, but not replace them with AI.

top_signals.headline: China consumer inflation rises less than expected in January as producer price deflation persists
top_signals.impact: China's consumer inflation rose less than expected in January while the deflation in producer prices persisted.

top_signals.headline: Getty Realty (NYSE:GTY) Posts Quarterly Earnings Results, Beats Expectations By $0.01 EPS
top_signals.impact: Getty Realty (NYSE:GTY) announced its quarterly earnings, reporting an EPS of $0.63, surpassing the consensus estimate of $0.62. top_signals.headline: T-Mobile’s stock turns higher after earnings. Here’s what’s impressing Wall Street.
top_signals.impact: The company gave an upbeat forecast for service revenue at its investor day on Wednesday, overshadowing some weak points in its fourth-quarter results.

top_signals.headline: FAA abruptly halted El Paso flights over Defense Department's plans for anti-drone technology
top_signals.impact: A Trump administration official said the Department of Defense disabled Mexican cartel drones that had breached U.S. airspace.

top_signals.headline: Cisco’s stock falls as investors pan a seemingly upbeat earnings report
top_signals.impact: The networking company sported AI momentum and delivered a rosy revenue outlook, but that wasn’t enough for Wall Street.

top_signals.headline: Novo Nordisk faces a defining year in the obesity drug market. It’s off to a dramatic start
top_signals.impact: The Danish drugmaker kicked off 2026 with its explosive obesity pill launch, but recent challenges have centered around protecting its market share.

top_signals.headline: Value is the key to McDonald's growth plans, but it's creating tensions with some franchisees
top_signals.impact: McDonald's has doubled down on value, which will likely help boost sales, but some franchisees are standing ground in their ability to continue to independently set prices.

top_signals.headline: Why the largest U.S. auto dealer isn't interested in Chinese cars — for now
top_signals.impact: But reasons such as politics, logistics or potential consumer backlash aren't necessarily the main reasons, according to Lithia Motors CEO Bryan DeBoer.

top_signals.headline: The jobs picture still looks muddy, even with surprisingly strong January growth
top_signals.impact: January job gains were better than anything the U.S. economy saw in 2025 but not still enough to sound an all-clear.

top_signals.headline: We're raising our price targets on 3 picks and shovel data center buildout stocks
